description: MediaPipe Hand Landmarker (tasks-vision 1.1.0, IMAGE mode) landmarks extracted from ASL fingerspelling reference photos, plus mirrored and rotated copies. Used to measure the ONNX letter model through the app preprocessing. Not webcam data; one signer.
source: ASL University / Lifeprint fingerspelling photos (https://www.lifeprint.com/asl101/fingerspelling/abc.htm); oldletters/<x>.jpg and <x>.jpg. Only derived landmark coordinates are stored.
fields: letter: intended sign; image: source photo id; mirrored: horizontally flipped copy (left-hand stand-in); rotation: degrees; handedness: MediaPipe label; points: 21 [x, y, z] normalized image coordinates
